title: ALTO simulator numeric helper accepts NaN as a passing comparison
description:
The new local number_is helper uses fabs(actual-expected)>tolerance, so a cached NaN passes. Exact unchanged-function synthetic proof returns true; environment/property/preset assertions use it. Reject nonfinite unexpected values/tolerance and use the shared corrected assertion contract. New custom helper scope is distinct from closed common ASSERT_NEAR findingbc8d-029. Fixed and reverified by the linked repair task; source and runtime limits remain recorded there.
